[[Sunspears in Kryta]] is the quest that allows characters in [[Lion's Arch]] to travel to [[Elona]] and start the [[Nightfall]] campaign.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Prophecies
| nationality = non-Elonian
| transfer = Nightfall
}}
* [[Sunspears in Cantha]] neither active nor completed

===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Lionguard Bedo]] to gain entrance to [[Lion's Gate]].
* Speak with [[Kormir]] in Lion's Gate.
* Defend [[Lion's Arch (Sunspears in Kryta)|Lion's Arch]] from the evil that threatens to destroy it.
* Speak with Kormir in Lion's Gate to arrange travel to [[Elona]] (see Notes below).
* See [[Seamarshal Bendro]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* Travel to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan port unlocked.

==Walkthrough==
Talk to Kormir in Lion's Gate. She will ask you if you are ready to face the danger that has come to Lion's Arch. When you respond "yes", you will be taken to the mission. Your party will be in a [[Lion's Arch (Sunspears in Kryta)|mission instance of Lion's Arch]], with mission rules. If your party is wiped out, the quest is failed.

There will be some fights with high level enemies, so it's strongly advised not to go alone. It may also be difficult to complete this quest using only the level 10 henchmen from Lion's Arch. You will, however, have four very hardy [[Lionguard Sentry|Lionguard Sentries]] following you.

You need to close four [[Chaos Rift]]s to defend Lion's Arch while fighting or avoiding groups of [[Wrathful Storm]]s (level 24 [[elementalist]]s), [[Scythe of Chaos|Scythes of Chaos]] (level 18 [[mesmer]]s), [[Grasp of Insanity|Grasps of Insanity]] (level 22 [[warrior]]s), and [[Torment Claw]]s (stationary level 22 warriors) in the area. To close a rift, stand under it and wait to capture it. A red bar on the left side of your screen will indicate how far the rift has to go to close and how quickly it is closing. When the bar turns blue, the rift has closed. 

Each rift is guarded by a Grasp of Insanity and either a Wrathful Storm or a Scythe of Chaos, sometimes with a Torment Claw as well. You may avoid killing them while you capture the rift, but they can capture the rifts back. Be wary of other groups that may be patrolling nearby. Once all four rifts are closed, a 30 second timer counts down. You must hold all four rifts during this time. 

Once your party is ready, head to Lion's Gate and talk to Kormir. Travel to Elona and get your reward.

==Notes==
* This quest unlocks the [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] [[port]] in [[Elona]] (once you have arrived at the [[Sun Docks]]).
* Make sure no party members leave after the [[Chaos Rift]]s are all destroyed, as you need to talk with [[Kormir]] (a second time) in [[Lion's Gate]] in order to travel to the [[Sun Docks]] in [[Elona]]. If all party members are not present, you will not be able to travel.
* Consider completing [[Mhenlo's Request]] and [[Sunspears in Cantha]] rather than this quest. You fight the same enemies in both versions of this quest, but entering from [[Kaineng Center]] gives you a full party size of 8, level 20 henchmen with stronger builds, and more and higher-level NPC allies.
* Whenever a character who has not visited Elona enters Lion's Arch, unless this quest or Sunspears in Cantha is in their log, the message ''"To unlock travel to Elona, take the "Sunspears in Kryta" quest from Lionguard Figo."'' will appear.
* See [[Campaign travel]] for additional information.

== Trivia ==
* One of the battle quotes from the ally NPCs is "It's the end of the world as we know it!", which is the name of a [[w:It's the End of the World as We Know It (And I Feel Fine)|R.E.M. song]].
